name: Bad Lauterberg im Harz (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre, slightly towards the hoist, with the city arms of Bad Lauterberg im Harz (a yellow lion on red above red and yellow bars).
history: The flag is red-yellow striped with the arms at the centre, slightly shifted towards the hoist; the banner is red-yellow-red 1:3:1 with the arms above the centre.

features.role: Bad Lauterberg arms — lion and bars
